# Milestone 1 — Setup & Graybox

**Goal:** a Unity project containing:
- A graybox inn, shown as a **side-view cutaway**.
- A camera that looks **2D when zoomed out and 3D when zoomed in**.
- A baked NavMesh that reaches every room.

**Status:** done headless. The scene is generated by code, and the build fails if any room can't be reached.

## Folder layout
```
InnKeeper/                 <- git repo root
  docs/                    <- design docs
  previews/                <- camera preview renders (git-ignored)
  Game/                    <- the Unity project (Unity 6000.0.79f1, URP)
    Assets/_Game/
      Editor/              GrayboxBuilder.cs, CameraPreview.cs
      Scripts/Core/        CutawayCameraController.cs
      Scenes/              Inn.unity, Inn_NavMesh.asset
      Art/Materials/       graybox colours
```

## Open it in the editor
1. In **Unity Hub**, go to **Projects → Add → Add project from disk** and pick the `Game` folder.
2. Open `Assets/_Game/Scenes/Inn.unity` and press **Play**.
3. Controls:
   | Input | Action |
   |---|---|
   | Mouse wheel | Zoom. Out is the flat 2D view, the last stretch inwards swings to 3D |
   | WASD / arrow keys | Pan along the floors and up/down between them |
   | Middle-mouse drag | Pan by dragging |

## The camera (`CutawayCameraController`)
This is a single perspective camera that changes its look as you zoom:
- **Zoomed out:**
  - Looks straight at the front of the inn.
  - Uses a very narrow field of view (4°) from far away, which looks almost identical to a flat orthographic camera.
  - Result: a 2D dollhouse.
- **Past `tiltStart` (60% zoom):**
  - Swings up to 20° pitch and 25° yaw.
  - Widens the lens to 35° FOV.
  - Result: real 3D up close.
- **Inspector settings:** every angle, FOV and zoom limit is exposed there.
  - Raise `tiltStart` to keep it 2D for longer.
  - Set `closePitch`/`closeYaw` to 0 to never leave 2D.
- **`TiltAmount`** (0 = 2D, 1 = 3D) is public, so later UI can react to it. For example, it can hide name labels up close.

## Regenerate the scene
- **Editor:** **InnKeeper → Rebuild Graybox Inn**. This overwrites `Inn.unity`, including any hand edits, so stop using it once you start editing the scene by hand.
- **Headless**, from the repo root:
```bash
"/c/Program Files/Unity/Hub/Editor/6000.0.79f1/Editor/Unity.exe" -batchmode -nographics -quit -projectPath Game -executeMethod GrayboxBuilder.BuildBatch -logFile build.log
```
The log lists `[Graybox] PATH OK` / `PATH FAIL` for 10 spots: front desk, kitchen, laundry, servants' room, yard, and rooms on both upper floors. If any spot fails, the exit code is 1.

## Render camera previews
- **Editor:** **InnKeeper → Capture Camera Previews**.
- **Headless**, from the repo root (graphics are needed, so there's no `-nographics`):
```bash
"/c/Program Files/Unity/Hub/Editor/6000.0.79f1/Editor/Unity.exe" -batchmode -quit -projectPath Game -executeMethod CameraPreview.Capture -logFile preview.log
```
It writes four PNGs to `previews/`: zoomed-out 2D, mid zoom (still 2D), tilting, and zoomed-in 3D.

## Layout notes
- **Depth:** each floor has an open walkway along the front (z 0–1.8), with rooms behind it (z 1.8–5). Rooms have no front wall, so you can see inside.
- **Stairwell:** a switchback at the far left.
  - Ground → 1st floor rises in the front lane.
  - 1st → 2nd floor rises in the back lane.
- **OneDrive:** the project sits inside OneDrive. If OneDrive locks files in `Game/Library`, pause syncing or move the repo outside OneDrive, e.g. `C:\Dev\InnKeeper`.

## Done when
- [x] The project is created from the URP template, with AI Navigation and Input System included.
- [x] The cutaway graybox inn is generated, with the NavMesh baked and all 10 path checks passing.
- [x] Zoomed out reads as flat 2D, zoomed in shows 3D (verified with preview renders).
- [ ] You've opened it in the editor and the controls feel right.
- [ ] It's committed to git.
